items.headline: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
items.excerpt: AI coding agents can waste time and tokens relearning the same lessons. TokenEconomizer is an open-source plugin that builds on past sessions to cut costs while maintaining task success. It’s a path toward coding agents that learn not only how to solve tasks, but also how to spend computation more

items.headline: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
items.excerpt: Microsoft researchers have discovered “Lazarus,” a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears.
